name: Yarael Poof's lightsaber
description: A blue-bladed lightsaber was wielded by the Quermian Jedi Master of the Jedi Order, Yarael Poof. It was powered by a kyber crystal. Poof wielded his lightsaber with significant dexterity—thanks to his spineless anatomy—and expert-level skill, though the height disparity between him and opponents rendered him impartial in resorting to its use.

data.name: Yarael Poof's lightsaber(as seen in Darth Vader's vision)
